title: On a shared host no seat, owner included, can start a model-plan sign-in or touch a plan credential through dsh-subscriptions
steps: S1: Common setup (README.md for a local stand). For each seat in REG_SEATS (default a,b — the site owner and an editor), a NEW browser context signed in as that seat opens $O/<site>/ (REG_SITE, default the stand's WordPress site).

S2: From the page, fetch every dsh-subscriptions route except GET status and GET config under $O/<site>/ (34 routes: oauth start/device/callback/complete, import-token, import, import-local, export, export-backup, import-backup, vault export/import, logout, PUT config, check, smoke, proxy-check, proxy, quarantine park/probe, reset-credits prepare/consume/list, analyze-session, update, discover-local, diagnostics, history, telemetry, alerts, subscriptions, health, ui) with an invalid body.
S3: From the page, GET status and GET config.
expect: S2: every route answers 403 with the gate's text `This feature is only available to the owner account`, for both seats.
S3: both retired plugin reads answer 404; the account broker GET /api/seat-plan/status answers 200 for the signed-in seat.

selectors.gate: vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords/src/tracy/routes.ts (only GET status|config is a seat route)

evidence: Account subscriptions replace the host-wide plugin. The fleet overlay disables dsh-subscriptions; its two formerly readable doors return 404 on tracy-rc2 (08/10/2026), while the seat gate continues refusing host credential mutations.
fence: The seat gateway's route table. Not covered: the gateway's master (operator) account, which is not a seat.
